abstract: Maintains ultra-low temperature cold storage validation and thermal mapping records
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic logistics officer (CLO), responsible for maintaining ultra-low temperature cold storage validation, thermal mapping records, and tracking cryogenic infrastructure telemetry across candidate aseptic fill-finish facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Liquid nitrogen backup reserves（NITRO）
information_points.content:
CLO-NITRO-KQF：Telemetry logs for AuraMed Sterile Tech Hub document a liquid nitrogen autonomy duration of 48 h supported by its on-site bulk liquid nitrogen storage tanks without external replenishment.
CLO-NITRO-Z2G：Cryogenic tank level telemetry logs establish that Vanguard BioPharma Center has a liquid nitrogen autonomy duration of 72 h of continuous backup refrigeration from its on-site bulk storage tanks without external deliveries.
CLO-NITRO-LL4：Cryogenic tank level telemetry logs indicate that the liquid nitrogen autonomy duration for Helix BioWorks Cantonal Facility is 96 h, reflecting continuous backup refrigeration supported by on-site bulk tanks without external delivery replenishment.

information_points.title: Maintains ultra-low temperature cold storage validation and thermal mapping records（COLD）
information_points.content:
CLO-COLD-9Q5：Thermal mapping qualification reports show that ultra-low temperature storage is validated for AuraMed Sterile Tech Hub, verifying that its on-site -80 °C bulk drug substance storage vault reliably maintains temperatures strictly below -70 °C under loaded conditions.
CLO-COLD-IXH：Thermal mapping qualification records confirm that ultra-low temperature storage is validated for Helix BioWorks Cantonal Facility, with its on-site -80 °C bulk drug substance storage vault maintaining temperatures strictly below -70 °C under loaded conditions.
CLO-COLD-P8O：According to thermal mapping qualification records, ultra-low temperature storage is not validated for Vanguard BioPharma Center, as its on-site -80 °C bulk drug substance storage vault failed to demonstrate compliance maintaining temperatures strictly below -70 °C under loaded conditions.
